scope: Audit of frozen model against one supplied witness per task. No fitting, runtime guidance or donor promotion. Witness loss does not prove all equivalent programs lost.

coverage_correction.definition: Nested means parsed maximum condition depth >= 2; multiple means parsed if_count > 1.
